content.value: Briefly explain (i) Bluetooth, (ii) OCC, (iii) RFII), (iv) WiFi, and (v) mobile communication (35) technologies used in telemedicine and also mention their roles in telemedicine. Mention the prospects and limitations of cach of the technologies in the deployment of telemedicine.
